video_title: The hardest part of Jayson Tatum's Achilles comeback wasn't physical | Dan Patrick Show | NBA on NBC

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his Achilles injury recovery and using Drennavx
quotes.excerpt: It's the mental hurdle that is the toughest and that is different for everyone.

text_blocks.speaker: Dan Patrick
text_blocks.text: Are these the meds that you took while you were coming back, the non-opioid meds that you were taking?

text_blocks.speaker: Jayson Tatum
text_blocks.text: Yes, so Drennavx would be the medication. It's a non-opioid for moderate to severe acute pain. I took it at my four-week mark. Rehab is obviously about phases and different processes and steps, and that was just a step where I was on crutches and in a boot, and it was the first time I was putting 50% weight-bearing on that surgical site. So my surgeon, Dr. O'Malley, we had a conversation and we talked about Drennavx, and for me it was perfect. I didn't experience any pain, any side effects, so it just gave me the confidence to continue to push forward. Physically, in this day and age, especially in professional sports with the best trainers and doctors and modern medicine, physically you're going to recover and you're going to be cleared to play. It's the mental hurdle that is the toughest and that is different for everyone, and it just takes time.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on consulting other players during his Achilles rehab
quotes.excerpt: I talked to KD a lot just because he was three, four weeks ahead of me.

text_blocks.speaker: Dan Patrick
text_blocks.text: Who did you talk to who had gone through blowing out their Achilles, other athletes?

text_blocks.speaker: Jayson Tatum
text_blocks.text: Yes, so I had obviously talked to KD, Damian Lillard, and Tyrese Haliburton. We were all, Dame was a few weeks before me, Tyrese Haliburton was a few weeks after me. I talked to KD a lot just because he was three, four weeks ahead of me, so I was just curious about how his transition was, what his next steps were, so all of us just being in the same boat at the same time, just kind of being helpful to each other.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's reaction to LeBron James signing with the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I just was kind of excited for the NBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Dan Patrick
text_blocks.text: What was your reaction when you heard LeBron had finally made his decision going to Philly?

text_blocks.speaker: Jayson Tatum
text_blocks.text: I just was kind of excited for the NBA. I think the buzz and the excitement level around this season is higher than in recent years. I think a bunch of different guys on new different teams, there's so many storylines that people love to talk about. I think the NBA is going to be super competitive this year and extremely entertaining.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on prioritizing the Celtics over other NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: I would say I'm more concerned about the Celtics.

text_blocks.speaker: Dan Patrick
text_blocks.text: Are you more concerned about Philly or the Knicks if I made you pick?

text_blocks.speaker: Jayson Tatum
text_blocks.text: I would say I'm more concerned about the Celtics. I respect everyone in the league, obviously great players and great teams, but from my experience throughout this going to be my 10th season, we got to worry about us first, that's first and foremost.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his relationship and history with Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: You can't talk about him without talking about me and vice versa.

text_blocks.speaker: Dan Patrick
text_blocks.text: What's the biggest misconception about your relationship with Jaylen Brown?

text_blocks.speaker: Jayson Tatum
text_blocks.text: There's just so many different narratives and so many different opinions and speculations. For me, I love that guy. What we were able to accomplish together in nine years, right, went to the conference finals five times, we went to the championship twice, we won a championship, we've shared All-Star games together. You can't talk about him without talking about me and vice versa, the success that we've had as just two young kids growing up in this league and really just pushing each other. Unfortunately, the business of basketball is always going to play a part. Nobody has ever played together forever, but it's not like a thing to be sad or upset about, it's a thing to celebrate what we were able to do.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on guarding LeBron James and Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I probably guard everybody at some point.

text_blocks.speaker: Dan Patrick
text_blocks.text: But when you play the Sixers, do you want to guard LeBron or do you want to guard Jaylen?

text_blocks.speaker: Jayson Tatum
text_blocks.text: I mean, I can't give away our game plan. I probably guard everybody at some point. The way that we play and the way that the game is played today, you switch and different matchups, so the fans, they'll get what they want to see.
